world.display_name: Storm Night - Cabin Living Room (1 plate) (standard)

assets.caption: Cozy rustic log cabin living room in the evening, seen at eye level from the center of the room. Ahead: a large river-stone fireplace with an empty cold hearth (clean iron grate, a little grey ash, no fire, no logs), a thick wooden mantel with a clock and candles, an empty wicker log basket and iron fire tools. To the right: a worn brown leather couch with a chunky knitted blanket under a large window showing blue dusk and pine silhouettes, a side table with a lamp, and an empty round dog bed in the corner. Behind: an open front doorway with no door onto a dim covered porch, coat hooks with a scarf and a lantern, a boot tray and a small bench. To the left: a small kitchen nook with a wooden counter, open shelves of mugs and jars, a kettle, a small round table with two chairs, and a wide-open back door onto a dark back porch. A braided oval rug on a wide plank floor, exposed log walls and ceiling beams. Soft even evening lamplight, warm amber with cool blue from the windows. Stylized semi-realistic animated-film look with hand-painted textures and rich teal, amber and magenta color. The room is empty and still: no people, no animals.
